title: Miso prawns with greens
summary: Miso prawns with greens is a japanese dinner built around raw king prawns and pak choi, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Have everything for Miso prawns with greens chopped before the pan goes on. Pat raw king prawns dry and season it.
steps.tip: A short cook only works if the chopping is finished first.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil in a wide pan and cook raw king prawns until just done. Lift it out.
In the same pan, cook pak choi and rice miso paste until hot and lightly browned. Return raw king prawns and toss with the lemon, lime or sauce.
Taste Miso prawns with greens, add salt if it needs it, and serve straight away.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
steps.tip: Taste Miso prawns with greens before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.
